summary: TWO-WEEK REPORT (08-28 → 09-11). The 09-04 run analysed the first half and never rendered, so nothing in here has been delivered to anyone yet. Read the two halves together, because the second half materially changed the verdict on the first. Half one (08-28 → 09-04) looked like a recovery: Stephski closed the Aug 1-14 wire mess ('Okay perf recieved', 08-30), issued the Aug 15-31 invoice correctly sequenced afterwards, and announced a credit; Vivek posted his first-ever messages in this chat 32 days after Derrek introduced him; Mica broke an 18-day reel-inspo gap. Half two undid most of it. On 09-04 Liza pushed back on the credit figure - 'You should had gotten more than that.. I’ll circle back with the receipts' - sent wire receipts on 09-07, chased on 09-08 ('So maybe you missed one of them'), and on 09-09 Stephski recalculated: 'Okay ive rolled over 7499.59 to this invoice so the new amount due is 4231.69'. The credit moved from $2,499.59 to $7,499.59. ALTR had under-credited its client by $5,000 for eight days and only found the money because she audited the books herself with screenshots. She paid the corrected invoice the next morning ($5,000 wire, tracking 20260909K4QLA01C001458, from Leticia Linss) and at window close Stephski has still only said 'I believe it came in just waiting for it to process and show your name' - no final confirmation. Meanwhile the account's actual emergency has not moved at all: on 08-31 Liza handed over plaintext passwords for @Lizakovaal, @lizkovalenkoo and @Lizaakovalenk0 at Vivek's request, Vivek said 'Okay on it', then 'Check dms', and has not posted a single message in this chat in the 11 days since. Zero recovery status on three deleted/suspended accounts. The passwords are still sitting in the group chat - and a ChatDeleteUser event fired on 09-03 and a ChatAddUser event on 09-10, meaning the membership of the room holding those credentials changed twice. Then on 09-10 Michelle chased her for content uploads ('I noticed there hasn’t been anything uploaded yet') for a management-run Instagram Reels account, while the Instagram accounts Liza reported deleted still have no status - exactly the tone-deaf sequencing that was flagged as a risk. Derrek has now been silent for 38 days and his 2026-08-01 Phone Farm commitment is 41 days old. Mayson is the only person routing anything on this account: he escalated to Vivek twice, escalated to Stephski on 09-08 ('@stephskiii ^'), and offered a call on 09-04 that got no reply and no follow-up.

On top of that: 11 days of total silence from Vivek after he took plaintext credentials for three deleted Instagram accounts, with no status on any of them and the client having stopped asking (disengagement, not satisfaction); those plaintext passwords still sitting in a ~20-person group chat whose membership changed twice during the window (ChatDeleteUser 09-03, ChatAddUser 09-10); Michelle chasing content uploads on 09-10 for accounts that are still down; Derrek at 38 days silent with the Phone Farm promise 41 days old; and the 09-09 wire still unconfirmed at window close. Held up from lower by genuinely good client behaviour and by Stephski and Mayson both responding same-day once escalated: she paid within a day of getting the corrected figure, her tone stayed warm throughout ('Perfect !', 'Thank you'), and she is still doing ALTR's reconciliation work for it rather than disputing the relationship.
